mechanism_narrative: The recent decline in WORKPLACES mobility from -10.7 to -9.7 while TRANSIT stays near -20 indicates a slow return of out-of-home routines that should continue lifting retail visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days even as WORKPLACES remains less negative than -10 and TRANSIT remains near -20.

mechanism_narrative: If residential time remains elevated while transit usage is suppressed, discretionary shopping gets displaced to home-based activity and retail visits stay lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 11 and TRANSIT stays below -20 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week average within 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 11 and TRANSIT remaining below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility is a leading indicator of broader outing intensity; when parks recover from a sharp negative shock, retail and recreation should improve in the following week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in the week after PARKS rises by 3 or more points, or moves lower instead.

mechanism_narrative: When workplace mobility and transit both remain materially below baseline, the city is still operating under subdued movement conditions that constrain shopping trips and keep RETAIL_REC below the prior month average over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stays below -8 and TRANSIT stays below -18 for four straight weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES stays below -8 and TRANSIT stays below -18 throughout.

mechanism_narrative: Rising grocery and pharmacy mobility reflects consolidation of essential trips, which crowds out discretionary retail visits and depresses RETAIL_REC with a one-week lag.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases in the week after GROCERY_PHARM rises, or does not fall when GROCERY_PHARM is above its recent 4-week average.

mechanism_narrative: A broad uplift in PARKS together with RESIDENTIAL staying flat indicates weather-driven or holiday-style leisure movement that spills into shopping and raises retail mobility over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -12 while RESIDENTIAL remains within 1 point of 11 to 12
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days even though PARKS rises above -12 and RESIDENTIAL remains near 11 to 12.

mechanism_narrative: A continued improvement in TRANSIT signals easier access to shopping districts; once transit stops being deeply negative, retail mobility should move up within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -20 after being below -20 in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after TRANSIT crosses above -20 from below.

mechanism_narrative: If workplaces remain suppressed while residential stays elevated, commuting-linked shopping demand will weaken further and retail mobility will drift down relative to the last month over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -10 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 11
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is higher over the next 28 days than over the previous 28 days after WORKPLACES falls below -10 while RESIDENTIAL stays above 11.
